views.name: v_post_user
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_post_user AS SELECT posts.Id AS post_id, posts.PostTypeId AS post_type_id, posts.Score AS post_score, posts.ViewCount AS view_count, posts.Title AS post_title, posts.Tags AS post_tags, posts.AnswerCount AS answer_count, posts.CommentCount AS comment_count, posts.FavoriteCount AS favorite_count, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS author_name, users.Reputation AS author_reputation, users.Location AS author_location, users.Views AS author_views, users.UpVotes AS author_upvotes, users.DownVotes AS author_downvotes, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, users.CreationDate, users.LastAccessDate, users.Age FROM posts LEFT JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

views.name: v_comment_details
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_comment_details AS SELECT comments.Id AS comment_id, comments.Score AS comment_score, comments.Text AS comment_text, comments.CreationDate AS comment_date, posts.Id AS post_id, posts.Title AS post_title, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS commenter_name, users.Reputation AS commenter_reputation, comments.PostId, comments.UserId, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, users.CreationDate, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age FROM comments LEFT JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id LEFT JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id

views.name: v_badges
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_badges AS SELECT badges.Id, badges.UserId, badges.Name, badges.Date FROM badges

views.name: v_badges_users
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_badges_users AS SELECT badges.Id, badges.UserId, badges.Name, badges.Date, users.Id AS users_Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age FROM badges INNER JOIN users ON badges.userid = users.id

views.name: v_posthistory_posts
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posthistory_posts AS SELECT postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId, postHistory.PostId, postHistory.UserId, postHistory.Text, postHistory.Comment, posts.Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate FROM postHistory INNER JOIN posts ON postHistory.postid = posts.id

views.name: v_posthistory_posts_users
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posthistory_posts_users AS SELECT postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId, postHistory.PostId, postHistory.UserId, postHistory.Text, postHistory.Comment, users.Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age, posts.Id AS posts_Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate FROM postHistory INNER JOIN users ON postHistory.userid = users.id INNER JOIN posts ON postHistory.postid = posts.id

views.name: v_posthistory_tags_users
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posthistory_tags_users AS SELECT postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId, postHistory.PostId, postHistory.UserId, postHistory.Text, postHistory.Comment, users.Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age, tags.TagName, tags.ExcerptPostId, tags.WikiPostId FROM postHistory INNER JOIN users ON postHistory.userid = users.id INNER JOIN tags ON postHistory.postid = tags.excerptpostid

views.name: v_postlinks_posts
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_postlinks_posts AS SELECT postLinks.Id, postLinks.CreationDate, postLinks.PostId, posts.Id AS posts_Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate FROM postLinks INNER JOIN posts ON postLinks.postid = posts.id

views.name: v_posts_tags
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posts_tags AS SELECT posts.Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, tags.TagName, tags.ExcerptPostId, tags.WikiPostId FROM posts INNER JOIN tags ON posts.id = tags.excerptpostid

views.name: v_posts_users_votes
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posts_users_votes AS SELECT posts.Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, votes.Id AS votes_Id, votes.PostId, votes.CreationDate, votes.UserId, votes.BountyAmount, users.Id AS users_Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate AS users_CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age FROM posts INNER JOIN votes ON posts.id = votes.postid INNER JOIN users ON votes.userid = users.id

views.name: v_posts_votes
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posts_votes AS SELECT posts.Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, votes.Id AS votes_Id, votes.PostId, votes.CreationDate, votes.UserId, votes.BountyAmount FROM posts INNER JOIN votes ON posts.owneruserid = votes.userid

views.name: v_tags
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_tags AS SELECT tags.TagName, tags.ExcerptPostId, tags.WikiPostId FROM tags

views.name: v_users_votes
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_users_votes AS SELECT users.Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age, votes.Id AS votes_Id, votes.PostId, votes.CreationDate AS votes_CreationDate, votes.UserId, votes.BountyAmount FROM users INNER JOIN votes ON users.id = votes.userid

views.name: v_votes
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_votes AS SELECT votes.Id, votes.PostId, votes.CreationDate, votes.UserId, votes.BountyAmount FROM votes
